heading: Notes
text:
## Notes
The hard part was matching bank lines to invoices when the reference text was missing. Dana built a scoring step for it and measured 97 percent exact matches on a frozen set of 500 payments.

heading: Stack
text:
## Stack
Python, FastAPI and PostGIS on a single small server. Costs about 40 euros a month.

heading: Incident story
text:
## Incident story
In March 2021 a nightly job at Northwind Freight posted 300 payments twice. Dana found the missing idempotency key within one hour.
